body.move1_summary: All 4 short-term recs get qualified FOR votes -- probabilities generally track Olrun's ranges but skew slightly lower once 2026 base rates are applied (worst tech offer-rates in 12 years, PH 3.1% avg conversion, cold-email warmup eating half the 30-day window). Agreed with Olrun on PH above cold outreach, cold outreach last.
body.move3_summary: 3 experiments proposed, each cheap/fast/isolates a specific channel Olrun's ranking blends together: (a) warm-referral velocity test, split out from cold-Upwork inside short-term-1; (b) micro-price willingness-to-pay probe on one module, before the full PH/studio bet; (c) manual cold-outreach vertical A/B (recruitment/staffing vs spatial/XR), before paying the 14-21 day Instantly warmup cost.
